peer_identity.arc_label: Steelhead from grafted infant to prime Metabaron seeking love—before Krleza merger
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Faceless/featureless head; head contains deadly weapons under helmets. Transactional—refuses altruism, demands payment. Prideful about combat supremacy. Emotionally volatile but admits openly he cannot love. Leveraged vampire crisis to demand Supreme Metabaron title. Searched 3,500+ planets for knowledge of love. Capable of stealth infiltration and assassination. Inherited Shabda-Oud psychic powers through mother.
peer_identity.rationale: Three-way split of Steelhead records. This card covers his arc from infant (vol08, grafted on Tonto) through young champion (vol09) to active Metabaron (vol10, dueling Aghnar) to the pre-merger warrior seeking love (vol11). These form a coherent continuous persona: ambitious, militarily dominant, prideful, admits he cannot feel love, searches 3,500 planets. Distinct from the in-Melmoth phase (subsumed warrior component) and the post-Melmoth phase (all-Storlon, reverted pure warrior).
